user.title: Connect to Nanobot
user.description: Home Assistant handles requests first. Nanobot is used only for unrecognized requests or targets. Select this agent in Assist and disable Prefer handling commands locally: this integration already performs that routing. The API must use bearer authentication.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Nanobot
reconfigure.description: Enter the API key again to update the endpoint.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Nanobot
reauth_confirm.description: Nanobot rejected authentication. Enter the current API key.

error.invalid_settings: Provide a name, an HTTP(S) URL without credentials, a nonempty API key and a timeout between 5 and 180 seconds.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the Nanobot agent API or validate its response.

abort.already_configured: This Nanobot endpoint is already configured.
